question.problem:
The basis $B$ of ${R}^{3}$ and the matrix $[\,T\,]_{B}$ of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{3}\to {R}^{3}$ relative to $B$ are given by

$$
B=\{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}6 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ -6\end{aligned}]\},\,[\,T\,]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 & c \\ a & -2 & 0 \\ -2 & b & -1\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the value of $\,a+b+c,\,$ given that  

$$
T({b}_{1})=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -1 \\ 12\end{aligned}],\,T({b}_{2})=[\begin{aligned}6 \\ -2 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,T({b}_{3})=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$
